# Introduction
The {{"template":"referral","description":"a resource","plural":false,"of":"self"}} is a resource introduced in {{"template":"referral","of":"to_base:mod_version / yam:u1"}} and reintroduced in {{"template":"referral","of":"to_base:mod_version / to_sky_and_stars:0.1.0"}}. It can be obtained by mining {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_sky_and_stars:uranium_ore"}}.

Once refined into {{"of":"minecraft:item / to_sky_and_stars:enriched_uranium"}}, it can be used in {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_sky_and_stars:atomic_bomb","plural":true}} to create a {{"of":"to_base:concept / to_sky_and_stars:nuclear_explosion"}}.

# Compacting

{{"of":"self"}}, like many resources in Minecraft, can be compacted into a {{"of":"minecraft:block / to_sky_and_stars:uranium_block"}} or broken down into {{"of":"minecraft:item / to_sky_and_stars:uranium_nugget","plural":true}}.
